asvs_statement: This map shows what was examined, not whether the project meets the standard.
asvs_level_source_option: Showing level {level} for this view. The project's recorded level is not changed.
asvs_level_source_project: Level {level}, as recorded for this project.
asvs_level_source_default: Level {level}. The project has not recorded a level yet; choose one to record it.
asvs_level_governed: Governed mode: the level only changes this view, it is not recorded in the project.
asvs_no_quality: No validation yet. Run a validation to see what it examined.
asvs_no_semantic: No Semantic run yet: requirements that only an AI review of the source can examine stay unexamined.
asvs_decisions_problem: {file} cannot be read ({problem}). It is not rewritten; fix it by hand.
asvs_shown_all: {count, plural, one {# requirement} other {# requirements}} shown.
asvs_shown_filtered: {count, plural, one {# requirement} other {# requirements}} shown, state: {state}.
asvs_na_governed: Governed mode: the project's decisions cannot be changed here.
asvs_decision: Recorded as not applicable at {id} on {date}: {reason}
asvs_check_open_findings: {count, plural, one {# open finding} other {# open findings}}
asvs_check_open_blocking: {count, plural, one {# blocking finding} other {# blocking findings}}
asvs_check_open_informational: {count, plural, one {# informational finding} other {# informational findings}} (does not block the validation)
asvs_ai_review_title: AI review of the source (apart from the deterministic checks)
asvs_ai_review_note: An AI model read the source for this requirement. It is counted apart and never replaces a deterministic check.
asvs_suggestion_all_section: Suggestion for every requirement of this section: {reason}
asvs_suggestion_all_chapter: Suggestion for every requirement of this chapter: {reason}
asvs_suggestion_governed: Governed mode: a suggestion cannot be recorded here.
asvs_shown_suggestions: {count, plural, one {# requirement} other {# requirements}} with a suggestion shown.
asvs_awaits: This requirement awaits evidence that JGates cannot read from the repository: {kind}.
asvs_evidence_deployment: how it is deployed and run
asvs_evidence_person: a person's answer or a process
asvs_no_check_for_languages: No JGates check examines this in the languages of this project.
asvs_text_english: The requirement text is the official English text.
asvs_na_lead_requirement: Record that {target} does not apply to this project.
asvs_na_lead_section: Record that every requirement of section {target} does not apply to this project.
asvs_na_lead_chapter: Record that every requirement of chapter {target} does not apply to this project.
asvs_na_reason_hint: {min} to {max} characters. The reason is shown on the row and kept in the project file.
asvs_na_entry_wait: Write the reason to see the entry that will be saved.
asvs_na_entry_created: {file} does not exist yet. Saving creates it with this entry:
asvs_na_entry_added: Saving adds this entry to {file} and changes nothing else:
